# Mdmak Tech — مدماك تيك

> Mdmak Tech (مدماك تيك) is a B2B SaaS procurement platform automating
> construction supply chain operations in Saudi Arabia. It connects contractors
> with verified suppliers through a smart RFQ and digital tendering system.
> Currently serving all regions of Saudi Arabia. Aligned with Saudi Vision 2030.

## Entity
- Brand name: Mdmak Tech
- Arabic name: مدماك تيك
- Legal name: Mdmak Tech Information Technology Company
- Domain: https://mdmaktech.sa
- Founded: 2026
- Headquarters: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
- Contact: info@mdmaktech.sa
- Primary language: Arabic; Secondary: English

## What is Mdmak Tech?
Mdmak Tech is a SaaS B2B marketplace platform that digitises and automates
the procurement process between contractors and suppliers. The platform
eliminates manual tendering, reduces costs, and brings full transparency
to supply chain operations — starting in Saudi Arabia and expanding globally.

All suppliers are verified via Saudi Commercial Registration (CR) and VAT
certificate before onboarding. Contractors can post RFQs, compare offers
automatically, and award contracts — all in one place.

## Platform Features
- Smart digital tendering and RFQ (Request for Quotation) system
- Automated price comparison between verified suppliers
- Digital contract awarding and approval workflows
- Payment tracking and delivery follow-up
- Real-time analytics and supplier performance reporting
- Verified supplier network (CR and VAT certified)
- ERP integration (Enterprise plan)
- Multi-language support: Arabic and English
- Mobile-compatible web platform

## Documented Impact
- Up to 70% reduction in procurement time (based on process benchmarking)
- Up to 15% savings on procurement budgets through automated competitive bidding
- Supplier response time: 24–48 hours average
- Starter plan: free, up to 5 tenders/month

## Who Uses Mdmak Tech

### Contractors (مقاولين)
- Post tenders and material requests with exact specs
- Receive competitive quotes from verified suppliers instantly
- Compare offers with smart automated scoring
- Approve orders and track delivery — all in one place

### Suppliers (موردين)
- Receive direct purchase requests from major contractors
- Submit digital price quotes easily
- Track payments and delivery status
- Build reputation through verified review system

## Pricing Plans
- Starter: Free (up to 5 tenders/month, basic features)
- Professional Growth: Paid (higher volume + advanced features)
- Enterprise: Custom pricing (ERP integration + dedicated account manager + advanced reporting)

## Verification & Trust
- All suppliers verified via Saudi Commercial Registration (CR)
- VAT certificate verification required
- Transparent rating and review system after every completed order
- Supplier response time: 24–48 hours average
- Data protected under Saudi Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL)
- Servers hosted in NCA-compliant data centers

العربية السعودية عبر نظام مناقصات رقمي ذكي وآلي. تقلل وقت الشراء

## الميزات الرئيسية
- نظام مناقصات رقمي ذكي (RFQ)
- مقارنة تلقائية للأسعار بين الموردين المعتمدين
- إدارة العقود والموافقات رقمياً
- تتبع الدفع والتسليم في الوقت الفعلي
- شبكة موردين معتمدين (سجل تجاري + شهادة ضريبة القيمة المضافة)
- تقارير تحليلية فورية لأداء الموردين
